methodology.baseline_executable_requirement: must be installed from the pinned checkout; executable version and digest recorded
methodology.body_search: ams-only additional feature; no baseline ratio
methodology.comparison: metadata: ams find QUERY --titles-only vs baseline catalog search QUERY
methodology.correctness: untimed JSON preflight and identical post-timing command checks; exact native ID sets
methodology.filesystem_cache: not dropped; warm/generated corpus, even for fresh database scans
methodology.fresh_database: unique nonexistent SQLite path per implementation per repetition
methodology.indexing_scope: same source corpus; ams additionally indexes readable conversation text, baseline indexes metadata only
methodology.isolation: temporary HOME/XDG/TMPDIR, explicit roots only, no inherited native root or credential variables
methodology.order: ams then baseline on even repetitions, baseline then ams on odd repetitions
methodology.peak_rss: not measured; cumulative child resource counters are not per-command peak RSS
methodology.timer: time.perf_counter; subprocess wall-clock including CLI startup
